mechanism_claims.claim_text: Hs IAPs bind model phospholipid vesicles, gain alpha-helical structure, and disturb DMPC or DMPC:DMPG phase transitions; this supports membrane-interaction activity but not a single resolved killing mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Hs02 suppresses LPS-induced TNF-alpha release and reduces lipid droplet biogenesis in murine macrophage assays at source-reported concentrations.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Hs02 adopts a micelle-bound alpha-helical structure over residues Ala3-Phe14 in DPC-d38, supported by NMR restraints and deposited structure identifiers.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Structural evidence explains conformation in DPC micelles and should not be overstated as an in vivo target mechanism.
